notifications_recipient_present.name: notifications_recipient_present
notifications_recipient_present.value: employee_id is not null or recipient_email is not null

time_entries_period_order.name: time_entries_period_order
time_entries_period_order.value: clock_out_at is null or clock_out_at > clock_in_at

shifts_status_matches_employee.name: shifts_status_matches_employee
shifts_status_matches_employee.value:
("shifts"."status" = 'assigned' and "shifts"."employee_id" is not null)
          or ("shifts"."status" = 'open' and "shifts"."employee_id" is null)
          or "shifts"."status" = 'cancelled'

shift_requests_one_open_per_target_shift.name: shift_requests_one_open_per_target_shift
shift_requests_one_open_per_target_shift.where: status in ('pending_colleague', 'pending_manager') and target_shift_id is not null

shift_requests_decider_has_time.name: shift_requests_decider_has_time
shift_requests_decider_has_time.value: "shift_requests"."decided_by" is null or "shift_requests"."decided_at" is not null
